_meta.note: These deliberately labelled, fully delimited frames are NOT captures or claimed layouts of Codex, Claude, or Devin. No live layout samples were supplied. Real unrecognized screens must be rejected; do not ask an Agent to print these markers.

rules.frame: Exact kind-specific synthetic header, BEGIN CONTENT, complete role blocks, END CONTENT, input> footer, state footer; nothing else.
rules.roles: USER, ASSISTANT, TOOL, APPROVAL start blocks; END closes each. Every body line starts with '| '. Markers inside a body line remain literal text.
rules.increment: Full baseline prefix, or unique baseline-suffix/current-prefix overlap with two nonempty body lines. Only whole new blocks are eligible.
rules.prompt: Exactly one newly added USER block, first in the new region, equal to the whole submitted prompt after CRLF and right-padding normalization.
rules.body: Only following ASSISTANT blocks. TOOL is excluded, APPROVAL stops extraction. Unknown boundaries never become raw output.
